Name: SCENARIO_PLACEMENT_PARAM_ST
Description: Where scenario characters appear (Roundtable Hold). Each row places the character of one story, optionally only while a given story is at a given stage and depending on event flags; when several rows place the same character, the one with the lowest Priority is used.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 1 on 4 rows (from row 1101), 0 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Placed Character Story ID
Fields.Description: The story whose character this row places. 1-8, 51 and 52 are the Nightfarers' personal stories (heroes 1-10: 51 = Scholar, 52 = Undertaker); the player's own hero is never placed. Other values are other characters' stories. Rows are matched to placed characters by this ID, Condition Story ID and Condition Story Stage.

Fields.Name: Condition Story ID
Fields.Description: The row only applies while this story is the active one and at Condition Story Stage. 0: no story active (uses the general stage). Values other than 0, 1-8, 11-40, 51 and 52 ignore the stage condition. Retail: 0 on 51 rows.

Fields.Name: Condition Story Stage
Fields.Description: The stage the condition story (or, with Condition Story ID 0, the general stage) must be at for this row to apply. Retail 1-5.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: When several rows place the same character, the row with the lowest value is used. Retail: 1, 50 (most rows), 75, 99 or 100.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: 1 on 287 of 330 rows.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Disable Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The row is ignored once this event flag is on. 0 or -1: no flag.

Fields.Name: Enable Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: The row only applies while this event flag is on. 0 or -1: always.
